scope: Point-in-time qualification contract for NEXT_SESSION_V1 decision at T after EOD finalization; no full-market dataset or strategy signals generated
security_type_rule: Use explicit dated provider/exchange type evidence available by decision_at. Ticker pattern, current code list, board or stock name cannot establish type. Unknown type fails closed.
lifecycle_rule: Use only events with effective_date <= trade_date and available_at <= decision_at from a verified complete as-of lifecycle source. Later delisting cannot erase earlier membership. Same-effective-date conflicts invalidate the day; absent or incomplete source is UNKNOWN_LISTING_LIFECYCLE, not fabricated NOT_LISTED.
trading_rule: Explicit TRADING, SUSPENDED or NON_TRADING status from an admitted as-of source. Missing bar or zero volume never proves suspension. Unknown or late status fails closed.
daily_regime_rule: Require validation_status=VALID, limit_applicable=true and exact validated limit_up_rate=limit_down_rate=0.10 for that security-day. Exclude no-limit, 5%, 20%, 30%, ambiguous and unsupported regimes. Board is descriptive or a dated rule-lookup input, never an override of the canonical constraint.
history_rule: For this contract baseline require 150 valid prior-or-current EOD stock trading observations available by decision_at and counted since the latest LISTED or RELISTED event, matching existing config warmup_trading_days=150. Do not calculate RSI14, MA5 or limit-up count here. Missing/invalid/late observations do not count; T final bar counts only for an after-EOD decision. Any changed lookback requires a versioned run context.
ipo_rule: No hard-coded IPO blacklist. A new listing is excluded naturally while no daily price limit applies or required history is insufficient.
special_state_rule: Delisting periods, relistings, long suspensions and special no-limit days use dated lifecycle, status and DailyTradingConstraint evidence; unresolved cases are ineligible.
pit_rule: Every causal source has effective date, available_at, source identity and frozen content hash; only information available at or before decision_at may determine universe(t). Later corrections create a new snapshot/version, never silently rewrite a prior run.
exclusion_reason_semantics: One deterministic primary enum is emitted by the validator's fixed type -> lifecycle -> trading -> constraint -> bar -> history validation order; secondary diagnostics may be retained separately but cannot change eligibility.
eligible_rule: Only explicit A-share common stock, known active listing, TRADING, VALID Gate B 10% daily constraint, valid T bar and 150 PIT-admissible history sessions at the approved cutoff is eligible. All unknown or conflicting cases fail closed.
determinism: Identical frozen raw snapshot, Gate B constraint version, universe contract version, execution policy/cutoff, lookback and trade date yield identical ordered security-day results.
